items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: François Michaud down there when I used to play. You couldn't tell who's who.

ctx.x: See? Of course, it's like this François Michaud down there when I used to play. You couldn't tell who's who. I guess right now, all of them is all mixed up. You can't tell who's who now.
